messages.subject: Highlight clade with linear gradual colored renctangle
parts:
Hello everyone,


I am new user of ggtree package so I would like to ask you about an aesthetic issue.

I am going to highlight a tree clade, but the color fill of the rectangle region I would like to be gradual fading from node to tips. I found the geom_hihlight function but I dint decipher how is doing gradient coloration. However , I found also gradient.rect function but I didn't manage to incorporate it into my ggtree overall function. Could you help me please?


Thank you
